Complete address-space inventory -> docs/address_map.json (+ summary in docs/inventory.md).

Every byte of the 1,048,576-byte ROM is assigned exactly one entry:
    class          code | dead_code | code_table | code_data | code_unreached |
                   compressed_asset | tiles | table | padding | zero_run | footer | unknown
    representation source    - produced by committed source (asm) - fully ROM-free
                   editable  - decoded into a documented editable format in gamedata/
                   generated - produced from layout metadata (fill runs)
                   opaque    - copied bytes from gamedata/raw (not decoded)
    evidence       what establishes the class

Inputs: build/trace.json, build/inventory.json (bank 4), assets/layout.json (data banks),
assets/annotations.json, tools/hints.py (external pointer tables).

15 dialogue scripts at 2000:C240-D95E: 14 from the word table 4000:BB84 (spawn_dialogue_box 4000:BBD4: [obj+18h] = cs:[BB84h+AX*2]); read by obj3d_update_text_window (4000:BD8C, ES=2000h); codes F0h-FFh dispatched through tbl_BD6C; every script ends with FFh (obj3d_text_end) and the next one starts right after it (one unreferenced script at C508h-C6A9h, between table entries 0 and 11); the last ends at D95Eh, followed by the prompt tiles at D95Fh. Runtime: obj3d_update_text_window

spawn_dialogue_box (4000:BC1A) copies 8 tiles from 2000:D95F to tile RAM 3980h (tiles 198h-19Fh) via copy_tiles_to_ram; obj3d_draw_text_window shows tile 198h + ((frame>>3)&7) while waiting on code F2h (8-step blinking prompt). Runtime: copy_tiles_to_ram

dialogue glyphs: text_put_glyph (4000:BEEE) copies 16 bytes from 2000:D9DF + AX*16, AX = script byte (< F0h) or code F3h label glyphs (table 4000:BBA0: B0h..D4h, +0..3); the 8-bit glyph index addresses exactly D9DFh-E9DEh, ending where the font starts. Glyphs 00h-D7h are used (scripts use 00h-AFh, labels B0h-D7h); D8h-FFh are blank (zero). Runtime: text_put_glyph (Japanese-ROM runs)

font: load_font_tiles (4000:B720) copies 400h words from 2000:E9DF to tile RAM 34B0h (ASCII 20h -> tile 14Bh); only the first 64 tiles (ASCII 20h-5Fh) are font data: the copy continues over the story sequencer table (2:EDDF) and FFh padding. End bound = start of the story table
